description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorPodsLifecycleManager class, which manages the lifecycle of executor pods in a Kubernetes environment for Apache Spark. It handles pod state transitions, deletion, failure tracking, and executor removal logic.

classes.name: ExecutorPodsLifecycleManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of executor pods in Kubernetes, including handling pod states, failures, deletions, and cleanup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager and subscribes to snapshot updates, handling executor failures.

methods.name: stopApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the given exit code.

methods.name: onNewSnapshots
methods.description: Processes new executor pod snapshots, updates executor states, and handles failed or missing pods.

methods.name: onFinalNonDeletedState
methods.description: Handles final states of pods that are not marked for deletion, removing executors and optionally deleting pods.

methods.name: removeExecutorFromK8s
methods.description: Deletes or marks a pod as inactive based on configuration.

methods.name: removeExecutorFromSpark
methods.description: Removes executor from Spark backend and caches the removal.

methods.name: findExitReason
methods.description: Generates an ExecutorExited object based on pod state and exit code.

methods.name: exitReasonMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed message explaining the executor's exit reason.

methods.name: findExitCode
methods.description: Extracts the exit code from a pod's container status.

methods.name: isPodInactive
methods.description: Checks if a pod is marked as inactive via labels.
